setup: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential postgresql-client ca-certificates git inotify-tools
warmup: mix local.hex --force && mix local.rebar --force && mix deps.get --check-locked

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U postgres -q; do sleep 1; done' && mix ecto.create && mix ecto.load --skip-if-loaded && mix ecto.migrate && mix run -e 'Hexpm.setup()' && exec mix run --no-start --no-halt -e 'base = String.trim_trailing(System.fetch_env!("HEXPM_PUBLIC_URL"), "/"); uri = URI.parse(base); for key <- [:cdn_url, :docs_url, :private_docs_url, :billing_url, :readme_url, :email_base_url], do: Application.put_env(:hexpm, key, base); Application.put_env(:hexpm, :img_url, base <> "/img"); Application.put_env(:hexpm, :readme_host, uri.host); endpoint = Application.fetch_env!(:hexpm, HexpmWeb.Endpoint) |> Keyword.put(:http, [ip: {0, 0, 0, 0}, port: String.to_integer(System.fetch_env!("PORT"))]) |> Keyword.put(:url, [scheme: uri.scheme, host: uri.host, port: uri.port]); Application.put_env(:hexpm, HexpmWeb.Endpoint, endpoint); Mix.Task.run("phx.server")'
